blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for condos and townhomes in Poplar. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Poplar, Abbotsford: 30 condos and townhomes listed at the end of September 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. By listings that is number 4 of 9 Abbotsford communities for condos and townhomes.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Abbotsford total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Poplar rose from 18 in June to 30 in September (+66.7%), and 17 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 5.2% of Abbotsford’s 572 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Poplar?
Poplar also had 27 houses listed and 2 sold in September, against 30 condos and townhomes listed. The Poplar houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Poplar?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 30 condos and townhomes listed in Poplar. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Poplar a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Poplar had a sales ratio of 10%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Poplar from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 17 condos and townhomes sold in Poplar over those 4 months, out of 318 in all of Abbotsford.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
